scope: Recorded input and bounded binary comparison; no additional console runs

instructions.limit: Address-aligned disassembly, complete NUL-terminated targets, and the first eight 32-bit table words (unchanged values or equal code destinations after the observed rodata-size shift). Not full table, arbitrary constant, control-flow or semantic equivalence. TARGET_DATA_UNCHECKED records only an equal instruction shape and corresponding rodata layout shift, not data equality.

limits: All differing/missing instructions, section lengths and unmatched relocations are reported. NUL splitting includes binary tables and does not explain all rodata bytes. SELF/package payloads and timestamps need separate inspection. Only the owner-confirmed installed candidate has hardware results.
